summary: Almonty Industries filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Notice of Annual General Meeting and Management Information Circular for the meeting scheduled June 9, 2026. The filing covers routine matters: receiving audited financials, setting board size at seven, electing directors, and confirming the auditor. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, special capital return, spin-off, restructuring, or other special situation is proposed. As a routine management information circular and AGM notice under Canadian law (mapped to equivalent SEC Schedule 14A), this filing does not constitute a special situation. What to watch: none; this is a standard procedural event with no risk-arb angle.
